title: Foundations: Riesz representation with absolute continuity (REP); Radon-measure compactness, convergence of restrictions and a measurable slice-mass majorant (T1, T2, MM); locality of integer multiplicity (IML)
statement: The conjunction of three propositions whose types are verbatim those of the DAG nodes cmc_exists_massRepresentation, cbr_measure_convergence_tools and cbr_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_local. (REP) Every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U ⊆ ℝ^P open, with M_W(T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U has a Borel μ (null off U, finite on compacts of U) and a μ-a.e. strongly measurable field ξ with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| everywhere, μ(W) = M_W(T) for open W and T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ; if moreover boundaryMassOn(T, W) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, then μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0. (T1) Measures μ_j with sup_j μ_j(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U have a subsequence μ_{φ(j)} and a Borel μ (null off U, finite on compacts of U) with ∫f dμ_{φ(j)} → ∫f dμ for continuous compactly supported f with tsupport f ⊆ U, limsup_j μ_{φ(j)}(K) ≤ μ(K) for compact K ⊆ U and μ(G) ≤ liminf_j μ_{φ(j)}(G) for open G ⊆ U. (T2) If X_j ⇀ X in 𝒟_k(U) with admissible representations (μ_j, ξ_j), (μ_X, ξ_X), μ is finite on compacts of U with limsup_j μ_j(K) ≤ μ(K), f is continuous and μ{f = t} = 0, then ∫_{f<t}ξ_j(ω)dμ_j → ∫_{f<t}ξ_X(ω)dμ_X for ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). (MM) If μ_j(G ∩ {a<f<b}) < ∞ and Z_j(t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ_j(G ∩ {t−h<f<t}) for t ∈ (a, b), there is a measurable g with liminf_j Z_j(t) ≤ g(t) for a.e. t ∈ (a, b) and ∫⁻_{(a,b)}g ≤ L·liminf_j μ_j(G ∩ {a<f<b}). (IML) Assuming (REP), (MR) (M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every IMRep R of T; type of accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure) and (IMC) (type of accepted cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub: (a) a.e. locality of approximate tangent spaces for nested Borel sets, (b) restrictions of IMReps to Borel sets, (c) differences of IM currents are IM, (d) |orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e.), every X ∈ 𝒟_k(U) satisfies: (1) if X has locally finite mass and every x ∈ U has a ball B_r(x) ⊆ U with X.restrictDomain to B_r(x) IM, then X is IM; (2) if X is IM, so is its restriction to every open V ⊆ U. Notation: SimonGMT currents, M_W = massOn W, ⇀ = WeaklyConvergesOn, Hⁿ = μHE[n], |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α, IM = IsIntegerMultiplicity, W ⊂⊂ U = CompactlyContained.
